correctness.rationale: Every conflicting edge pair in W_n is enumerated by spoke clique, rim cycle and four forbidden spoke neighbours; independently checked against literal diamonds for n=5..34. Offset i+3 meets the degree lower bound n. Exact n! multiple holds because all spoke assignments are permutations. For fixed k, factorial moments of adjacent rim collision count converge to 1, with overlapping runs O(1/n), proving Poisson(1) and e^-1. Independent exhaustive list enumeration checked n=5..7.

originality.rationale: Exact optimal-colouring count and Poisson(1) rare-conflict limit for the entire wheel family are not derived by the inspected primary sources. Verma 2026 covers only four-rim wheel conflict graph as a local lemma, while the planar bound 2Δ−1 cannot determine the wheel count or n-colour optimum. Semantic mathematical-record searches and prior-literature comparison found no covering equivalent. Residual priority risk remains for unindexed specializations of circular list-colouring enumerations.
